name: Skylanders Academy
s: Travel the vast Skylander universe in this animated series as a ragtag group of academy graduates build trust and heart in their fight against evil.

paragraphs.text: Skylanders Academy is an animated television series produced by TeamTO and Activision Blizzard Studios based on the Skylanders series. The first season premiered on Netflix on October 28, 2016. A trailer for the series premiered on October 12, 2016. The second season was released on October 6, 2017 and the third and final season was released on September 28, 2018.
